Once you're done drooling over the artwork on this card (created by our expert artists), imagine getting one in every sealed deck game! Add any ability 2 pilot, and you've got a destiny draw. Play with all your TIEs... you're guaranteed to have a way to move them around. The Dreadnaught gives them a power boost, too. For constructed-deck contests, note that this bruiser is non-unique. It has a little less power than the Victory-class ship, but it's cheaper and has the same forfeit. More than a match for those pesky [[Corellian]] Corvettes, she stands toe-to-toe with the [[Tantive IV]]. Combos: [[Kessel (Dark){{!}}Kessel]] + Dreadnaught + 4 TIE Fighters: For a deploy cost of 4, get power 13 and forfeit 13 with ability of 6.
